name: potluck
description: Throwaway VMs and sandboxes for coding agents on Macs and Linux boxes you own.
long_description: Potluck pools a team's idle Macs and Linux boxes. Its MCP server gives an agent sandbox tools: create a fresh VM or sandbox, run commands, start background processes, read and write files, extend, stop, restart and delete it. This bundle starts the Potluck you installed (`potluck mcp`); install Potluck and make a pool first: https://potluck.sh

pool.title: Pool
pool.description: The Potluck pool to use. Leave empty when this machine is in one pool.

potluck_path.title: potluck program
potluck_path.description: Full path to potluck when it is not on PATH or in ~/.local/bin. Leave empty to find it there.
